import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n > 40:
        print(0)
        return

    points = []
    for _ in range(n):
        a = int(next(it)); b = int(next(it)); c = int(next(it)); d = int(next(it)); e = int(next(it))
        points.append((a, b, c, d, e))

    if n < 3:
        print(n)
        for i in range(1, n+1):
            print(i)
        return

    result = []
    for center_idx in range(n):
        center = points[center_idx]
        vectors = []
        for i in range(n):
            if i == center_idx:
                continue
            p = points[i]
            vectors.append((
                p[0] - center[0],
                p[1] - center[1],
                p[2] - center[2],
                p[3] - center[3],
                p[4] - center[4]
            ))
        bad = False
        for i in range(len(vectors)):
            for j in range(i+1, len(vectors)):
                dot = (vectors[i][0]*vectors[j][0] +
                       vectors[i][1]*vectors[j][1] +
                       vectors[i][2]*vectors[j][2] +
                       vectors[i][3]*vectors[j][3] +
                       vectors[i][4]*vectors[j][4])
                if dot > 0:
                    bad = True
                    break
            if bad:
                break
        if not bad:
            result.append(center_idx + 1)

    print(len(result))
    for idx in result:
        print(idx)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
